_meta.warning: Same caveat as cannabinoids.json: ClassifyWithConfidence() is procedural — name-first-then-description-fallback, a coherence matrix that DELETES incompatible forms after detection, and pet/apparel short-circuits BEFORE form detection ever runs. This is the exact algorithm that ADR-002 / the facet refactor (01-ARCHITECTURE.md §4) replaces the single-category-column version of. Port the control flow as Go code in internal/resolve/facets.go; these word lists are the loaded-from-JSON data.
three_failure_modes_that_drove_this_desi: Negated marketing copy: "No need to smoke or vape; take the capsule with water" made a capsule vapeable. Fix: negation windows stripped before any matching.

Description noise beating the name: descriptions are marketing copy that mentions every other form for contrast. Fix: name is authoritative; description-derived forms are used ONLY when the name yields nothing, and that fallback is flagged low-confidence (ambiguous=true).

Physically impossible combos: "Bach Flower remedy" became smokable (bare word "flower"), tinctures became smokable, gummies became vapeable. Fix: a coherence matrix removes combinations that cannot coexist in one product.

exclusive_precheck_order: pet — NAME-first, then source category breadcrumb, then a STRONG description phrase only (loose 'safe for pets' cross-sell copy on human products must never match; warning sentences like 'keep out of reach of children and pets' are stripped before this check runs)
apparel — NAME or breadcrumb ONLY, never description (avoids 'free tee with purchase' cross-sell reclassifying a wellness product)
form_word_list_note: All compiled as case-insensitive, word-boundary alternation (\b(?:word1|word2|...)\b), phrases matched literally. NEVER strings.Contains — "joint" was removed from the smokable list entirely because bare-substring matching caught "joint pain".
nutrition_gate: form set is empty AND no cannabinoid word matches AND a nutrition word matches -> facet=nutrition
concentrate_note: A pure concentrate ("not diluted with any carrier oil", dab, distillate) is trusted as vapeable from the DESCRIPTION too — unlike other form signals it's a physical property, not marketing noise. Trusted only when the product isn't already edible_solid or topical.
negation_strip_pattern: (?i)\b(?:no need to|without|instead of|alternative to|not (?:for|meant for|intended for)|don'?t|do not|never|avoid)\b[\s\w]{0,20}?\b(?:smok|vap|inhal)\w*(?:\s*(?:,|or|and)\s*(?:smok|vap|inhal)\w*)*
negation_note: Both patterns are applied to name AND description BEFORE any form detection runs, not as a post-hoc filter.

coherence_matrix.run_order: topical FIRST (cosmetic names carry food-flavour words like 'Lip Balm — Chocolate' that would otherwise win as edible), then edible_solid, then tincture, then vapeable
coherence_matrix.if_edible_solid_delete_note: extract is deleted here too — a gummy is MADE WITH extract, but its consumption form is gummy, not extract.

raw_extract_auto_edible: extract present AND none of {edible, edible_solid, vapeable, tincture, beverage} present -> also append 'edible' as a secondary (raw RSO/FECO with no other form is most commonly ingested orally).
form_priority_note: First matching form in this order after the coherence matrix runs becomes the PRIMARY category. edible_solid and edible both map to the public category name 'edible'.
precedence: form over extract; name over description; pet/apparel checked before any form detection
